passages.text: The following discussion and analysis of the Company’s consolidated financial condition and results of operations should be read along with the consolidated financial statements and the accompanying notes thereto included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This discussion contains forward-looking statements that involve numerous risks and uncertainties, including, but not limited to, those described in Item 1A, “Risk Factors” and the “Cautionary Statements” section of this Item 7 below. You should review Item 1A “Risk Factors” of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for a discussion of important factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from the results described in or implied by the forward-looking statements contained in the following discussion and analysis. The Company has elected to omit discussion of the earliest of the three years covered by the consolidated financial statements presented except for the segment analysis. Information pertaining to fiscal year 2023 results of operations and the year-over-year comparison of changes in our Financial Condition and Results of Operations as of and for the year ended December 31, 2024 and 2023 can be found in Part II, Item 7, “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024, filed on February 12, 2025. These forward-looking statements are based on current management expectations and assumptions only as of the date of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. They are not guarantees of future performance and they involve substantial risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict and that could cause actual results to differ materially from the results expressed in, or implied by, these forward-looking statements. (“Entegris”, “the Company”, “us”, “we”, or “our”) is a leading supplier of critical advanced materials and process solutions for the semiconductor and other high-technology industries. We leverage our unique breadth of capabilities to provide customers with innovative, science-based solutions to their toughest technology challenges, helping improve productivity and product performance in the most advanced manufacturing environments. Semiconductors, or integrated circuits, are key components in electronic devices that continue to transform how we live, communicate and work. Many products and emerging applications—including artificial intelligence (“AI”), high-performance and cloud computing, smartphones, wearable technology, electric and autonomous vehicles, the Internet of Things, gaming, virtual/augmented reality, and smart healthcare— are expected to drive long-term secular demand for semiconductor and require faster, more powerful, more compact and more energy efficient semiconductors. Industry forecasts project semiconductor sales reaching approximately $1.6 trillion by 2030, which we believe will create significant opportunities for our products. As semiconductors move to smaller geometries and new device architectures, they require innovative materials and stringent purity standards throughout manufacturing. Entegris offers the industry’s most comprehensive electronic materials portfolio, with core capabilities in materials science and materials purity, and complementary solutions that accelerate time to yield. We believe these capabilities are critical enablers of our customers’ technology roadmaps. We expect these trends to create significant opportunities for our products, expand our served addressable market and increase Entegris’ content per wafer, positioning us to outperform our markets over the long term. credit_strengths.text: Entegris holds a leading position supplying critical advanced materials and process solutions to semiconductor manufacturers, with demand underpinned by secular growth in artificial intelligence, high-performance computing and advanced device architectures. This niche positioning supports pricing power and content-per-wafer expansion, and operating margin sits above the sector median, indicating relative profitability strength despite cyclical end markets.

Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure comfortably, leaving free cash flow that covers a modest portion of debt. The liquidity profile is solid, with current assets well in excess of current liabilities and a current ratio far above the sector median, providing a buffer against near-term obligations and working capital swings.

key_risks.text: Leverage is the dominant credit weakness. Gross and net leverage sit far above the sector median, and the indicative financial risk profile is highly leveraged. Interest coverage is weak relative to sector peers, leaving limited cushion for earnings volatility. The debt stack is largely fixed-rate notes, but refinancing risk concentrates in the coming years.

The debt note shows a large maturity wall: senior secured notes and a term loan due in the same year, plus unsecured notes due the following year. The term loan is subject to excess cash flow payments, which could divert cash from other uses. Refinancing this concentration depends on market access and could pressure liquidity if conditions tighten.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Debt service is supported by operating cash flow, but coverage is thin. Interest coverage is well below the sector median, and free cash flow to debt is modest, meaning internally generated funds cover only a small slice of the debt burden. The company relies on continued cash generation and refinancing to manage maturities.

Cash on hand is limited relative to debt, so net leverage remains elevated even after netting cash. The maturity profile is back-loaded, with no significant repayments due in the next two years, but the concentration in later years requires proactive refinancing. Shareholder distributions absorb a portion of free cash flow, modestly reducing deleveraging capacity.

overall_credit_view.text: Entegris is a highly leveraged issuer with a strong market position and solid liquidity, but weak coverage and elevated leverage relative to sector peers. The indicative financial risk profile is highly leveraged, and the maturity wall in the coming years is a key monitorable. Deleveraging depends on EBITDA growth and disciplined capital allocation.

Our forward view is cautious: leverage sits above the sector median and coverage is thin, leaving little headroom for a demand downturn. The semiconductor cycle and customer concentration are material risks. Refinancing the concentrated maturities is the key event risk. We would need to see sustained EBITDA growth and debt reduction to improve the credit profile.

credit_strengths.text: Entegris在半導體製造商所需關鍵先進材料及製程解決方案供應方面佔據領先地位，需求受人工智能、高效能運算及先進裝置架構的長期增長所支撐。此利基定位支持定價能力及每片晶圓含量擴張，而經營利潤率處於行業中位數以上，顯示儘管終端市場具週期性，相對盈利能力仍強。
經營現金流穩健覆蓋資本開支，留下自由現金流覆蓋部分債務。流動性狀況穩固，流動資產遠超流動負債，流動比率遠高於行業中位數，為短期債務及營運資金波動提供緩衝。

key_risks.text: 槓桿是主要信用弱點。總槓桿及淨槓桿遠高於行業中位數，指示性財務風險狀況為高度槓桿。利息覆蓋相對行業同業疲弱，為盈利波動留下的緩衝有限。債務結構主要為固定利率票據，但再融資風險集中於未來數年。
債務票據顯示龐大到期牆：高級抵押票據及定期貸款於同一年到期，加上無抵押票據於次年到期。定期貸款須支付超額現金流，可能分流現金至其他用途。再融資此集中到期依賴市場准入，若市況收緊可能對流動性構成壓力。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 債務償付由經營現金流支持，但覆蓋薄弱。利息覆蓋遠低於行業中位數，自由現金流對債務比率適度，意味內部產生資金僅覆蓋小部分債務負擔。公司依賴持續現金產生及再融資以管理到期債務。
手頭現金相對債務有限，故即使扣除現金後淨槓桿仍高企。到期結構後置，未來兩年並無重大還款到期，但後期集中需要主動再融資。股東分派吸收部分自由現金流，適度降低去槓桿能力。

overall_credit_view.text: Entegris為高度槓桿發行人，擁有強大市場地位及穩固流動性，但相對行業同業覆蓋疲弱且槓桿高企。指示性財務風險狀況為高度槓桿，未來數年的到期牆為關鍵監測事項。去槓桿取決於EBITDA增長及紀律性資本配置。
我們的前瞻觀點審慎：槓桿處於行業中位數以上且覆蓋薄弱，為需求下滑留下的空間有限。半導體週期及客戶集中為重大風險。再融資集中到期為關鍵事件風險。我們需要看到持續EBITDA增長及債務減少以改善信用狀況。
